desktop_release_gate: Every external publication independently verifies all three runtime targets; a development requireComplete=false override cannot bypass publication validation.
release_provenance: scripts/native-provenance.py records each build's source commit, bridge tree, go.mod/go.sum, compiler, Go toolchain, SHA-256, and size; collect rejects mixed-source or modified binaries and emits dist/native-source-lock.json.
release_gate: Publication requires resolved provenance/licensing, verified platform binaries, successful full verification workflow, a matching release-v<SDK version> tag on a release(scope): commit, and signing credentials.
